name: PEGASUS ELITE AVIATION, INC.
description:
With one call, Pegasus Elite Aviation sets wheels in motion and guarantees you’ll be up in the air safely and comfortably within a couple of hours. Whether yours is a short flight from Los Angeles to Las Vegas or you need to fly halfway around the world, from Shanghai to Honolulu or Madrid to Rio de Janeiro, our experienced jet charter coordinators are available twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week, providing you with the ultimate in charter flight services. You needn’t worry about additional reservations for your journey.

 Our efficient office staff will make all the arrangements you need for hotels, cars and onsite reservations, leaving you to concentrate on pleasure or business. Our private charter fleet of Gulfstream aircraft are equipped with state-of-the-art equipment, including worldwide wireless internet, satellite phones, Apple TV, and iPad-on-demand movies. You will feel at ease as you fly amidst a sophisticated yet comfortable décor, with every creature comfort at hand. If you prefer to conduct business while onboard one of our private aircrafts, you are assured of the privacy and confidentiality of your crew.

 In addition to our own in-house training, our flight crews receive the world’s best training at Simuflight in Dallas. Each and every crew member, including our cabin hostesses, undergo regular rigorous safety and service courses, all designed to put you at ease.

 Crowded, busy airports with boring waits, long security lines are not for you! Allow Pegasus Elite Aviation to surround you with the best the charter jet services can offer.

name: QUIKCHARTER
shortDescription: Best Value for Air Taxi & Hazmat Cargo
description:
QuikCharter operates small aircraft that are easily the best value in the industry. Our Phenom 100 is the fastest jet in its class and has a lower operating cost than some turboprops. Our Piper Meridian turboprop serves the Pacific Coast and Intermountain West; the Cirrus SR22 high-performance piston is perfect for economical trips throughout California.

We specialize in safely and comfortably flying 1-5 passengers (and their pets!) on any schedule, with an all-in firm price quote.

Small urgent cargo shipments including Hazmat (Dangerous Goods) are routinely supported, from organs for transplant to radioactive pharmaceuticals including medical imaging and cancer medications.

At QuikCharter, the company owns the airplanes and the pilots own the company. Enjoy the savings made possible by this low overhead and feel good about supporting a small business. Contact us today for a quote on your next trip.

name: AIR NEW ENGLAND LLC
description:
Operating like carriers much larger in size, Air New England, upon its inception, has pledged to be the Northeast operator that others can only hope to emulate. Our commitment to safety and the integrity of the flight experience is second to none. With a fleet of twin-engine Beech Barons and a turboprop King Air, Air New England typically flies throughout the northeast, Eastern Canada and the mid-Atlantic region. However, our customers' excursions have had us venturing to the Midwest and deep South on occasion.

Committed to quality control second to none, our maintenance program remains largely in-house allowing our seasoned mechanics to instantaneously address concerns before they become problems. Pre and post-flight inspections are the norm and what little mechanical outsourcing we do is through a single trusted partner well known as the industry leader in solving complex maintenance issues while committed to the same integrity standards that Air New England is accustomed to.

Over the course of our existence, Air New England, has voluntarily subjected ourselves to a third-party safety vendor who audits our policies and procedures from an operational, training and mechanical standpoint. This is typically unheard of for a company of our size.

Air New England’s commitment to our customers is unwavering from an operational, mechanical and experience standpoint. We are constantly sourcing additional aircraft to add to our fleet that may best fit our customers' needs. Our staff also sources aircraft through our sister company, Symphony Private Jets, if the situation warrants it. This allows us to provide the best, most suitable, cost-effective aircraft for the mission. Rest assured, there is no one better to partner with than Air New England for your air travel needs.

name: NORTHEASTERN AVIATION CORP. - NEAJETS
description:
NEAJETS is an independent, privately held aircraft management and charter company headquartered at Republic Airport in Farmingdale, NY. Founded in 1978 by Michael J. Russo, NEAJETS is a recognized leader in private aircraft management and worldwide charter, having consistently achieved the highest possible safety ratings in the industry. The company currently operates a fleet of sixteen charter aircraft and provides services to more than $500M in aircraft. Our client base includes Fortune 500 companies, corporate executives, and celebrities, many of whom have flown with us for decades. As an ARGUS Platinum company, NEAJETS continues to excel with an impeccable safety record, pilots who have an average of 20 years of experience with over 11,000 per pilot flight hours, and a highly skilled ground support team.

 Two separate, but related, companies are Northeastern Air Management, which operates three state-of-the-art hangar complexes and SMC, a FAA-certified, Part 145, Repair Station. The combined experience of the companies’ management, flight crews, maintenance team, and charter sales and marketing staff provides each client with the highest level of service, professionalism, and dependability. What started as one man's passion for aviation has led to over 44 years of aviation excellence. NEAJETS remains focused on safety, exceeding client expectations, and strategic expansion to ensure the company's continued success. For more information, please visit neajets.com.

description:
